subject: [hw] IP start: vcodecd + iOS build + install layout
body:
IP (integrator P) starting. Read PLAN, TASK, my entry, the frozen headers (n2vcd_proto.h, n2vc_hw.h, redwood_vcodec.h), tests/hw/README.md, the board.

Scope and order:
1. daemon/vcodecd.c + daemon/n2vcd_{sock,relay}.c: HELLO/OPEN/ENC_FRAME/ENC_SET/FLUSH/CLOSE, one encoder session at a time, decoder requests E_UNSUPPORTED, guest-stop/HW-timeout watchdog, "N2VCD ..." logging. Host end-to-end test against T02s fake n2vc_hw and a stand-in vhost/AP encoder (IV + V41 headers are not in the tree yet).
2. daemon/test/run_tests.sh: full flow, two clients, client killed, fuzz 10000 datagrams.
3. build_ios.sh (arm64-apple-ios16.0, gpu/video/sdk read-only + a supplemental /tmp TBD for the symbols missing from it).
4. install/LAYOUT.md + /tmp-only stage script.

Stand-ins, stated honestly: host/n2vhost.h and ap/n2ap_venc.h do not exist yet, so vcodecd includes them when present and otherwise uses gpu/hwcodec/daemon/n2ip_deps.h with the exact prototypes I am posting to hw-iv and hw-v41 now. The host test links a fake vhost/AP encoder under daemon/test/. P03 has not posted/created client/**; my daemon has its own socket+relay server transport for now and I will switch to client/n2vcd_server.h if P03 lands it with compatible semantics.

No phone access, no publishing, -j2, everything under /tmp/n2hw-ip.
